title: Strong monoidal descent of exact open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U$ an arbitrary open. Specify derived categories of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and modules on the over-site of $U$ with morphism universe $w$ [def-pc-derived-category]. On $U.toScheme$ use the standard derived category with morphism universe $u+1$. Let $R$ be the composite of the derived over-site restriction with the derived functor of $Modules.overEquiv(U)$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. For the recorded K-flat derived tensor monoidal structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], there exists a strong monoidal structure on $R$ (invertible unit and tensor comparisons satisfying naturality, associativity and both unit laws). No internal-Hom comparison or uncurrying equation is asserted.

proof.text: Identify tensorPullback U.ι with restrictFunctor U.ι using uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward; overFunctorEquiv then identifies the exact composite R = overFunctor ⋙ overEquiv.functor with tensor pullback. Transport finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation along this natural isomorphism.

Apply Mathlib Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts to the exact pullback factorization mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh. Use the across-universes left-derived counit and Functor.leftDerivedUnique to identify exact mapDerivedCategory with derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses U.ι. Compose mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso of the module comparison to obtain an isomorphism from the displayed derived composite to the transported pullback.

Take CoreMonoidal structures on the source and target standard-localization equivalences, induce the inverse-equivalence monoidal structure, and compose them with the standard derivedPullback monoidal model. Unfold derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses and use composition of strong monoidal functors. Transport this structure to the displayed derived composite via Functor.Monoidal.transport of the inverse comparison.

theorem exists_openRestriction_derivedMonoidal (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ E
    Nonempty R.Monoidal
